title: Structural Refactor of Store Architecture to Domain Level Abstractions
description: Structurally refactor the sketchpad store architecture to eliminate Yjs Map/Array primitives from the public API. RMap/RArray/RDoc become internal implementation details. Stores expose domain-typed APIs only. All Rx type aliases removed. Observer utilities internalized. The term 'yjs' should not appear in sketchpad code. The 'what' (kit synchronization) matters, not the 'how' (Yjs CRDTs).
summary:
Completed structural refactor of store architecture removing all Yjs/Rx terminology and replacing with domain-level Sync abstractions.

Changes:
1. studio.ts: Rewrote entirely - RMap→SyncMap, RArray→SyncArray, RDoc→SyncDoc interfaces. YjsDoc→CrdtDoc (internal). createYjsDocFactory→createSyncDocFactory. YDocBinaryPersistenceProvider→SyncBinaryPersistenceProvider. Removed export of Y, IndexeddbPersistence, Doc.
2. shared.ts: All Rx/Yjs types renamed (RxPath→SyncPath, RxAttributes→SyncAttributes, etc). XState bridge renamed (createRxSyncActor→createSyncActor, YjsSyncContext→StoreSyncContext, yTransact→syncTransact). Event types Y_UPDATE→SYNC_UPDATE. RemoteProviders.yProvider→syncProvider.
3. Sketchpad.tsx: All 73+ Rx type aliases renamed (RxKit→SyncKit, RxDesign→SyncDesign, etc). All store classes renamed (RxCoordStore→SyncCoordStore, etc). All r-prefixed members renamed (rMap→syncMap, rDoc→syncDoc, rKit→syncKit, etc). All y-prefixed locals renamed. All Yjs comments removed. Fixed kitApp name collision.
4. Kit.tsx: All RMap/RArray→SyncMap/SyncArray. All Rx types renamed. All r/y-prefixed vars renamed.
5. index.ts: Updated exports (YDocBinaryPersistenceProvider→SyncBinaryPersistenceProvider, RxProviderFactory→SyncProviderFactory).
6. compose.ts: Fixed pre-existing ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array type errors for gltf-transform API.

Build: Successfully builds. Tests: All 22 vitest tests pass.
